import os
import sys


def main():
    with open("./data/lines.txt", "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()
    # Every line, including the last, ends with a newline, so newline count = line count.
    n = data.count(b"\n")
    os.makedirs("./out", exist_ok=True)
    with open("./out/answer.txt", "w", encoding="ascii", newline="\n") as f:
        f.write(str(n) + "\n")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
